mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_RECOMMEND_HISTORY (MEMBER_ID, SENTENCE, PROFILE_JSON) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{sentence}, #{profileJson})

INSERT INTO TBL_RECOMMEND_ITEM (HISTORY_ID, RANK_NO, POLICY_ID, REASON, EFFECT) VALUES
(#{item.historyId}, #{item.rankNo}, #{item.policyId}, #{item.reason}, #{item.effect})
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID, MEMBER_ID, SENTENCE, PROFILE_JSON, CREATED_AT FROM TBL_RECOMMEND_HISTORY WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, HISTORY_ID DESC

SELECT I.RANK_NO, I.POLICY_ID, I.REASON, I.EFFECT, P.POLICY_NAME, P.POLICY_ORGANIZATION_NAME, P.POLICY_LARGE_CATEGORY, P.POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE, P.POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE FROM TBL_RECOMMEND_ITEM I LEFT JOIN TBL_POLICY P ON P.POLICY_ID = I.POLICY_ID WHERE I.HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} ORDER BY I.RANK_NO
